displayName: ElderGuard: calls accepted but none reached live in 24 h

conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query: { fetch cloud_run_revision :: logging.googleapis.com/user/elderguard_inbound_accepted | align delta(24h) | group_by [], sum(val()) ; fetch cloud_run_revision :: logging.googleapis.com/user/elderguard_media_started | align delta(24h) | group_by [], sum(val()) } | join | value [accepted: val(0), started: val(1)] | condition accepted >= 3 && started == 0

documentation.content: The Guardian Line answered calls but no media stream ever started. The WebSocket URL, token, or PUBLIC_BASE_URL is probably wrong after a deploy.
